primary_sources.locator: Retained primary main text, flattened line 46: amplicon Methods, bacterial composition and core succession, Discussion limitations.
primary_sources.coverage: Whole canonical record and batch 96 historical contract read, with selected main-text passages. No new full scientific review, ASV reclassification, supplementary abundance matrix, figure-pixel or stock/genome analysis.

Prevotella_1, Prevotella_7, Prevotellaceae_YAB2003_group, Rikenellaceae_RC9_gut_group, and Selenomonas_1

occurrences.source_assessment: The source's Prevotella_1 bin dominates the rumen inoculum and barley-straw enrichments. Its existing broader NCBI genus descriptor has a generic correspondence; this does not reclassify the SILVA bin or identify a genome.

occurrences.name_scope: Preserve Prevotella_1 separately from Prevotella_7, all source notes and absent strain designation.

occurrences.source_assessment: Prevotella_7 is a distinct SILVA bin in alfalfa and revived communities. Sharing the NCBI genus and reference population with index 0 does not collapse these reported bins.

occurrences.name_scope: Retain source-preferred Prevotella_7, including the quoted source's Prevotell_7 spelling; no taxon or stock identity is invented.

records.historical_guard_assessment: Only the fifteen declared GTDB descriptor fields and actual native history events may change. Preserve all source-preferred SILVA bins separately even where two share the same NCBI genus; family mappings remain broader than YAB2003/RC9 bins. These are four separately enriched substrate lines, not a 15-isolate SynCom. No species, MAG, strain, ASV reclassification, taxon abundance or functional assignment is supplied by generic correspondence. Preserve the distinct G0 versus G1-G10 vessel sizes, 72 h serial transfers, pooled inoculum and bacterial-only V1-V2 scope. All three current COMMUNITY_LEVEL nodes and the sole PARTIAL selection-to-phenotype direction remain; no niche partitioning, necessary-member contribution, hydrogen/methane flux or interspecies exchange is established. The existing three discussions, original source evidence, issue 1767 disposition and immutable batch 96 ledger remain intact. Strict successor admission may project only the admitted predecessor for old byte and last-LLM assertions, while every current biological predicate and unrelated Rifle/SF356/SIHUMIx chain remains enforced. This is preparation for a partial technical assessment, not a new full scientific review.
